description: Validates the provided value against a regex and returns a boolean plus a friendly message
label: Regex Validate

options.name: regex
options.label: Regex
options.info: The regular expression pattern to validate the value against.

options.name: flagCaseInsensitive
options.label: Case insensitive
options.info: Adds the 'i' flag. Ignores letter case when matching.

options.name: flagMultiline
options.label: Multiline
options.info: Adds the 'm' flag. Makes '^' and '$' match the start/end of each line instead of the whole string.

options.name: flagSingleLine
options.label: Single line (dotall)
options.info: Adds the 's' flag. Makes '.' match newline characters as well.

options.name: flagUnicode
options.label: Unicode
options.info: Adds the 'u' flag. Treats the pattern as a sequence of Unicode code points.

options.name: flagSticky
options.label: Sticky
options.info: Adds the 'y' flag. Matches only from the position given by the regex's lastIndex, so subsequent matches must be contiguous.

options.name: value
options.label: Value to validate
options.info: The value to validate using the regex.

options.name: invalidMessage
options.label: Invalid message

meta.default: Value does not match the required pattern.

options.info: The message returned when the value does not match the regex.

options.name: valid
options.label: Valid
options.info: Whether the value matches the regex.

options.name: message
options.label: Message
options.info: The invalid message when the value does not match, otherwise an empty string.
